terra.problem: The statement that Herod appears elsewhere in the Gospels is a Bible fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
The passage does not say the Pharisees are on Jesus' mind or that they are in the room. The mention of the earlier dinner also needs a reference.
The explanation repeats the verse without adding much and sounds flat rather than like Papa Dorin.
Papa comments on how he tells the passage: he says he would rather stick to the text than add an ending.
“I only tell it the way it's written” comments on how Papa tells the passage.
The passage does not establish that the Pharisees are present in the scene.
Jesus says people confess Him before men; He does not say that means the crowd in this scene.
“I'll leave it exactly the way He said it” comments on how Papa tells the passage.
Calling Moses Israel's leader is a Bible fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The explanation repeats that Moses is not in the passage and otherwise sounds flat and generic.
“That's the answer on the card” refers to the lesson card rather than speaking naturally to the baker.
The explanation repeatedly identifies the word without adding much, leaving it flat and generic.
